name: chat-form-dropzone
blurb: Chat input with drag-and-drop file attachments and inline thumbnails.
description: Combines file uploader with a text input field. Displays dropped/selected images as thumbnails; supports max 4 files up to 1MB each.
use_when: Chat interfaces or comment forms where users attach images with messages.
avoid_when: Mobile touch interfaces—drag-and-drop is not gesture-friendly.
a11y: FileInput includes aria-roledescription for each uploaded file. Input field is keyboard accessible.
